ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight in the healthcare industry. I would start by analyzing public records and conducting interviews with key stakeholders.
